scope: Five previously verified public README-linked images downloaded to work review and visually inspected. Two selected screenshots copied unchanged to public/project-media with detected native extensions. No feature code or authentication used.
publicationNotes: README-linked screenshots document the pictured interface, not current deployed behavior or live data availability.
All five downloads were visually inspected. Two selected files preserve native source bytes; SHA-256 digests and dimensions recorded below.
SkyView globe.png and main.png contain JPEG bytes despite URL extension and response MIME. Imported globe uses .jpg.
Campus Bookshelf source README declares display size 1280x677; actual PNG dimensions are 2560x1354. Initial HEAD403 was followed by a successful public GET without authentication.
Public image URLs follow the README-observed main branch and may change. Selected local files preserve the reviewed snapshot.
